fixed.explanation: `removeRedundantNames` clears a wrapper span's ref on enter, because the span is not a leaf generic yet. Later `inlineTextIntoGeneric` turns it into a text-only generic, and `removeNameRepeatingChild` removes it because its text equals the parent's name. The button's name is then dropped as redundant, since all of its contributors look represented, so both the name and the text are lost. The fix re-marks a removed node's ref as pending, so the ancestor keeps its name. I couldn't see `isLeafGeneric`, so this is inferred from the distiller code and untested.
